config_bundle.description: Path to the config zip bundle
config_bundle.rationale: Path to the API proxy/shared-flow config zip bundle. This is free-form, team-authored proxy content (XML/JS/Java) plus a filesystem path reference; a generic platform policy cannot meaningfully constrain an arbitrary embedded bundle, so it is out of scope.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

detect_md5hash.description: A hash of local config bundle in string, user needs to use a Terraform Hash function of their choice. A change in hash will trigger an update.

name.description: Name of the API proxy. This field only accepts the following characters: A-Za-z0-9._-.
name.rationale: It sets the name of API and doesnot have any security impact

org_id.description: The Apigee Organization name associated with the Apigee instance.
org_id.rationale: It sets the Organization name of API and doesnot have any security impact
